How each measure is defined

Weeks meeting goal
Completed participant-weeks (days 1–7, 8–14, … from joining) with movement on at least the participant’s own weekly goal. Self-reported; simulated demo journeys are excluded.
Returned within 7 days
A lapse is two or more days with neither movement nor a chosen rest day. Of lapses observed for at least a week, the share followed by movement within 7 days.
Detour acceptance and completion
Acceptance is detours started ÷ times “Plans changed” produced suggestions. Completion is detours finished ÷ detours started.
Retention
Participants with any movement or chosen rest in week 2 (or week 4), among those observed through that week.
Privacy
Events are pseudonymous and contain no names, contacts, location or free text. Any group smaller than five participants (or five offers) is suppressed.
